answer: A convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, priced above any epoch reward. Each verifier locks a bond before its signature counts, like a sable in a crystal case: visible to all, instantly forfeited for signing garbage. An attacker must capitalize every fake identity with a full bond, since weight equals slashed collateral, and the slash exceeds epoch rewards, so corruption loses money. Honest agents thrive; the garden of sybils withers because copies cost capital and cheating burns it.
